sources.title: Iranian Churn
sources.verified: 3,150 rows, fourteen CSV columns; eleven retained predictors; provider describes9-month aggregates, month12 target and3-month planning gap. CSV lacks per-customer timestamps.
sources.caveat: Provider Charge Amount prose says0-9; actual CSV maximum10. Anonymous ID is mentioned in prose but no ID column appears in this downloaded CSV. Status/Customer Value excluded conservatively; no proven-leakage claim.
sources.public_redistribution: Aggregate results/hashes with attribution only in this release; raw CSV and row-level audit remain local. Code downloads the official source when reproduced.
